map.：赔付率(发生/报告) = 500/400 = 125%。>100% 说明已发生: : the incurred/reported loss ratio = 500/400 = 125%. Above 100% means incurred exceeds reported, so IBNR remains to be booked.

map.已发生比已报告多 25%，差额即 IBNR 规模；进展因子随账龄成熟趋向 100: Incurred exceeds reported by 25%, and that gap is the IBNR magnitude; the development factor trends toward 100% as the triangle matures.
map.已发生赔付率大于100% 一定亏吗？: Does an Incurred Loss Ratio Above 100% Definitely Mean a Loss?
map.未必当季亏。已发生赔付率含 IBNR 与未决，若含大量未决准备金则当期现金未流出: Not necessarily a loss that quarter. The incurred loss ratio includes IBNR and outstanding claims, so with a large pending reserve no cash has left yet; but staying above 100% means pricing is inadequate and rates need raising or the business shrinking.
